Patient.description: A person registered with the practice for care. A first name alone is not an identity.

Clinician.description: A dentist, hygienist or dental nurse working at the practice.

CareTeam.description:
Which clinician looks after a patient as their dentist or their hygienist.
Treating a patient once does not make a clinician their dentist.

Cover.description: A working arrangement between clinicians: one supervises another, or stands in as their locum.

Treatment.description: A procedure for a patient. prescribed_by decided on it, performed_by carries it out, assisted_by is the nurse at the chair. A wish for treatment is not a booking.

LabOrder.description: An appliance ordered from the dental lab. ordered_by placed the order, fitted_by fits it. fitted stays empty until a fitting is recorded.

questions.q: Which treatments did Arjun Mehta-Rao perform?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Clinician)<-[:performed_by]-(n1:Treatment) WHERE n0.name = 'Arjun Mehta-Rao' RETURN n1.procedure AS procedure

questions.q: How many teeth did the crown prep involve?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Treatment) WHERE n0.procedure = 'crown prep' RETURN n0.teeth AS teeth

questions.q: What procedures and states does Zainab Karam have?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Patient)<-[:patient]-(n1:Treatment) WHERE n0.name = 'Zainab Karam' RETURN n1.procedure AS procedure, n1.state AS state

questions.q: What states are the crown treatments in?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Treatment) WHERE n0.procedure CONTAINS 'crown' RETURN n0.state AS state

questions.q: Was anaesthetic used for the extraction?

questions.q: Is there a record of anaesthetic for the whitening session?

questions.q: Which items has Mateus Carvalho ordered?
